decisions.reason: As a modular multi-model camera line in the firm's core domain, it offers continuing option value at low holding cost and faces little immediate abandonment pressure.
The sensor suite remains a strategically relevant adjacent option worth keeping while mission demand becomes clearer, even if its prospects are less certain than the standard camera lines.
A radiation-hard camera product line with several models fits the firm's heritage and future direction, so keeping it open is a low-risk way to learn and win contracts.

The asteroid navigation and imaging camera is the niche product with the weakest visible commitment, but it still builds on existing capabilities and is worth retaining as a real option for potential deep-space programs.
